'''Bacrana Orbital Spacedock A''' was an [[Orbital Space Dock III]] constructed by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. It was the largest of the eight spacedocks that comprised the [[Bacrana Shipyards]] in the [[Bacrana system/Legends|Bacrana system]].
